name: Schwalmtal (Hesse, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schwalmtal (a wolf's hook, a wavy bend and an oak leaf on black and yellow).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality on 18 May 1988 and is described as the arms on the upper half of a black and gold cloth.

features.role: Schwalmtal arms — wolf's hook, wavy bend and oak leaf
